meta.title: Alliance championship — Kingshot 777
meta.description: TL;DR guide to the Kingshot Alliance Championship for regular members: when to sign up, how the march snapshot works, and what you get.

tldr.heading: TL;DR
items: Sign up Monday 00:00 → Wednesday 23:00 UTC. Town Center 10+. Miss the window and you sit the week out.
Registration is a snapshot. Your march and every buff active at that moment are frozen in — pet buffs stay even after they expire.
Don't touch your team after registering. Updating it re-snapshots and you lose the buffs you locked in.
Then you're done. Battles run automatically Thursday to Saturday — you do not need to be online.
Formation: 50/20/30 infantry/cavalry/archers is the safe pick; 60/40/0 with no cavalry lowers your visible power for softer matchups and beats the standard build.
Heroes: pure damage only. Fights are short — take flat attack buffs and burst (Amadeus), skip tanks like Helga, and avoid anything with a sub-50% skill trigger.

rewards.heading: Rewards
items: 1 enemy march defeated: 10× 5-min research speed-ups, 20× 10k bread, 20× 10k wood, 40× 1k stone, 10× 1k iron.
2 enemy marches defeated: 15× 5-min research speed-ups, 30× 10k bread, 30× 10k wood, 55× 1k stone, 15× 1k iron.
End of event: alliance-wide rewards based on your final bracket rank and your tier — Stone, Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold or Diamond.

tips.heading: Tips
items: Register with your buffs up. Pop your pet buff and anything else temporary before you sign up — the snapshot keeps them for the whole week.
Register early. The alliance needs at least 10 participants or matchmaking fails and nobody gets anything.
Only re-register if your setup genuinely improved. Better troops or stronger active buffs are worth it; otherwise you're trading away a good snapshot for a worse one.
Nothing is locked away from you during the fights — your troops are busy in the lane, but the event needs no clicks. Play normally.

qa.a: A weekly alliance-vs-alliance tournament. Your alliance is matched against five others and fights them over five automated rounds across three lanes.
Every week, Monday 00:00 UTC to the following Monday 00:00 UTC. Sign-ups close Wednesday 23:00 UTC, the five one-hour battle rounds run through to Saturday 12:00 UTC, and rewards land after that.

qa.q: What do I actually have to do?
qa.a: Register one march for a lane during the sign-up window. That's it — nothing during the fights. Lane placement is handled by leadership.

qa.q: What's the score next to my name?
qa.a: Your combat score. It sets your fighting order inside the lane — the biggest score fights last.

qa.q: Why did my march not fight?
qa.a: Only the 20 strongest players assigned to a lane step up. And once your march has beaten two enemies — or been defeated — it's finished for that hour.
